text: Check deck feasibility and model limits
Distinguish a working market from correct arithmetic.

The proposed complete online deck is a new construction, not a recovered original inventory. A market can be mathematically well defined and still prevent several teams from meeting their required minima. Feasibility needs to be checked across a whole group, especially under scarce essential categories. Draw order, bidding strategy and shared supply can change outcomes.

items: Illustration: Enough cards may exist in total while too few capacity cards are available for all ten teams to qualify.

text: Verify that the class as a whole can build viable designs before tuning competitive fairness.
A simulation cannot prove learner understanding or real-world platform behavior.
